  Synopsis: One box, two screens.
  Scene sc1  INT. FIRST SCREEN  (line 11, transition: default)
    Elements
        box           show    @tl .box "A box"
        cap           show    @bc .muted hidden "The caption"
        old           show    @mr .label "Old news"
        foot          show    @bl .muted "Footer"
    Lines
      sc1.l1  (speed 0.9)
        "This box sits in the corner. [[next]] The caption says what it is."
      sc1.l2
        "Look at the box. [[focus: box]] [[sfx: pop]]"
  Scene sc2  INT. SECOND SCREEN  (line 27, transition: auto-animate from sc1)
    Elements
      - old           exit    @mr .label "Old news"
      ~ box           update  cell tl→mc, classes box→box accent
      ~ cap           update  text "The caption"→"The new caption"
        foot          same    @bl .muted "Footer"
      + new           enter   @tr .title hidden "New arrival"
    Lines
      sc2.l1  (pause 0.5 s)
        "Same id, new place. [[sfx: whoosh]] [[next]] A new element enters."
